defect_found_and_fixed_persist_condition.evidence: Real, previously-untested, live production defect: claimsFutureActionWithNoPlan (Defect C's gate, part of the #35 commit thread) corrects result.summary in-memory but was never added to the work_orders.output persist condition a few lines below (index.ts ~4198) - by construction it can only fire when groundedOutcomeThisTurn is false and model!=='deterministic-confirmation', so it could never have satisfied any pre-existing branch of that condition. Effect: the safe corrected text was visible only in that one request's SSE stream; work_orders.output (read by getChatHistory on reload, and by the next turn's own conversationHistory/lastTurnOutput) kept the ORIGINAL uncorrected raw text forever. Fixed by adding '|| claimsFutureActionWithNoPlan' to the persist condition.
